title: The dispatch profile is pi on GLM 5.3, executor cloudflare-sandbox
description:
The routing already exists and the executor now exists; this tick pairs them, which neither shipped profile does.

  profiles-herdr/ pairs pi with cloudflare-workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3 - KEEP that routing - and with executor herdr, for which there is no server in the container. Replace that half with cloudflare-sandbox.
  profiles/ pairs the right executor family with claude + sonnet. Keep neither half.

.tick/runners.toml's [roles.implement] already says implementation runs 'entirely on GLM on cloudflare through pi', so this is the repo's stated intent being honoured rather than a new direction - hn0 diverged from it by taking whichever compiled-in profile happened to have a local executor.

Two tiers, because wne is coming: glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash both need to be nameable as a worker model here. Do not build wne's classifier in this tick - just make sure the profile shape does not assume a single model per role, so that wne maps a work type onto a model that already has somewhere to land.

acceptance_criteria: A dispatch profile exists pairing runner pi, executor cloudflare-sandbox and model cloudflare-workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3, both glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash are nameable as a worker model, no profile the container can select starts a claude process, and go test -short ./... passes
